# Datfuslab Technologies

> Datfuslab Technologies Pvt. Ltd. provides custom software, website development, mobile applications, digital marketing, and Donexia NGO CRM solutions for businesses and nonprofit organisations in India.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://datfuslab.com/): Company overview, expertise, industries, workflow, and contact information.
- [About Datfuslab](https://datfuslab.com/about-us): Company background, mission, vision, and capabilities.
- [Contact](https://datfuslab.com/contact): Contact Datfuslab about a software or digital project.

## Services

- [Custom software development](https://datfuslab.com/software-development): Bespoke business software, CRM, ERP, integrations, and ongoing support.
- [Website design and development](https://datfuslab.com/website-design): Responsive business websites and web development services.
- [Mobile app development](https://datfuslab.com/mobile-app-development): Android and iOS application design and development.
- [Digital marketing](https://datfuslab.com/digital-marketing): SEO, social media, PPC, and performance marketing services.
- [Bulk SMS](https://datfuslab.com/bulk-sms): Transactional alerts, OTPs, reminders, promotional SMS campaigns, API integration, and delivery reporting.
- [Bulk WhatsApp messaging](https://datfuslab.com/bulk-whatsapp-message): WhatsApp campaign, notification, customer-support, template, and business integration services.
- [Bulk email](https://datfuslab.com/bulk-email): Bulk email campaigns, audience communication, delivery management, reporting, and business integration services.
- [Web hosting](https://datfuslab.com/web-hosting-server): Managed website hosting, migration, SSL, backups, performance resources, and ongoing assistance.
- [Linux server management](https://datfuslab.com/linux-server): Linux server provisioning, security hardening, web-stack configuration, monitoring, backup, and maintenance support.
- [Windows server management](https://datfuslab.com/windows-server): Managed Windows Server setup, IIS configuration, security, monitoring, backup, updates, and technical support.

## Product

- [Donexia NGO CRM](https://datfuslab.com/ngo-crm-software): Donor and donation management, 80G receipts, campaigns, communication, reporting, integrations, and annual pricing plans for Indian NGOs.
- [Create a Donexia account](https://datfuslab.com/signup): Donexia signup and trial request.
